description:
## Goal

Provide ongoing test-support engineering for WXO integration with mcp-context-forge: triage reported issues, clarify scope with the WXO team, and file fixes or feature changes as needed.

Related wxo issue: https://github.ibm.com/WatsonOrchestrate/wo-tracker/issues/68217

## How work lands here

- Bug reports filed against this repo or surfaced by the WXO team.
- Discrete fixes or features that fall out of those reports get their own sub-issues + PRs; this issue is the umbrella.

## Lifecycle

This issue stays open the lifecycle of the corresponding wxo issue.
